intro: A student team building a trustworthy coffee-leaf disease assistant for Ethiopian farmers — from a cleaned dataset to a deployed, explainable web app.

members.focus: Coordination, architecture, integration and final delivery
Dataset download, validation, duplicate detection and leakage-safe splits
Transfer learning, training recipes and model comparison
Metrics with confidence intervals, calibration and error analysis
Heat maps, robustness tests and the out-of-distribution gate
FastAPI service, Streamlit app and deployment
